title: Web client: static file serving at /
description:
Add rust-embed dependency to the workspace and kithd crate, then implement static file serving so kithd serves /web assets at the root route. What: Embed /web directory into kithd binary at compile time; serve at / via fallback route. Algorithm: 1. Add to /home/mark/WORK/KITH/Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies]: rust-embed = { version = "8", features = ["axum"] } and mime_guess = "2" 2. Add to /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kithd/Cargo.toml [dependencies]: rust-embed.workspace = true and mime_guess.workspace = true 3. Create /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kithd/src/static_files.rs: - use rust_embed::Embed; #[derive(Embed)] #[folder = "../../web/"] pub struct WebAssets; - pub async fn static_handler(uri: Uri) -> impl IntoResponse: strip leading /, default empty to index.html, call WebAssets::get(&path), on hit return ([(header::CONTENT_TYPE, mime_guess::from_path(&path).first_or_octet_stream().as_ref().to_owned())], content.data).into_response(), on miss if no extension return WebAssets::get("index.html") as SPA fallback, else 404. 4. In /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kithd/src/lib.rs build_app(): add mod static_files; and .fallback(static_files::static_handler) AFTER the three JMAP routes and BEFORE .layer(TraceLayer). 5. Create /home/mark/WORK/KITH/web/index.html with Kith
6. Create /home/mark/WORK/KITH/web/app.js and /home/mark/WORK/KITH/web/style.css as stubs (content added by other beads). Defensive programming rules: - Never unwrap() on WebAssets::get() — handle None as 404. - Content-Type MUST be set; use first_or_octet_stream() as safe default. - No path traversal risk: rust-embed validates at compile time. - Fallback to index.html only when path has no file extension. Tests (in /home/mark/WORK/KITH/crates/kithd/tests/ integration test): - GET / returns 200 with Content-Type: text/html - GET /style.css returns 200 with Content-Type: text/css - GET /app.js returns 200 with Content-Type: application/javascript - GET /nonexistent (no extension) returns index.html (SPA fallback) - GET /nonexistent.xyz returns 404 - JMAP routes still work: /.well-known/jmap not shadowed
